clue.text: Act evasively to trace a viper in another guise

indicators.note: appearing in another guise means the letters of these words are dressed up in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone tries to disguise a snake's trail by tracing it in a new form.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in another guise' rearranges TRACE A VIPER (eleven letters) into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To prevaricate is to speak or behave evasively, dodging the truth.

clue.text: See what has been written about publicity

parts.note: re is the Latin-derived word for about or concerning
an ad is a piece of publicity, an advertisement

explanation.surface: Look at the coverage a press campaign has received.
explanation.definitionFit: To read is to look at and take in written words.

clue.text: After six we get up to give an opinion

indicators.note: after says the second piece follows the first in the answer

parts.note: VI is six in Roman numerals

indicators.note: in a down clue getting up means the letters are read from the bottom upwards, backwards

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: We rise after six o'clock and then share our thoughts.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'get up' signals reading upwards; 'After' puts the turned pronoun behind the Roman numeral.
explanation.definitionFit: A view is a personal opinion or way of seeing a matter.

clue.text: Again sat and rested

definitions.meaning: to re-pose is to sit for a portrait or photograph a second time
lay or sat at ease, in repose

explanation.definitionFit: Read as re-posed it means modelled again; as one word it means lay down at rest.

clue.text: A little lower

parts.note: a lower is something that lows, that is moos, so a little one is a young cow

explanation.definitionFit: A young bovine, which will grow into a mooing cow, is a small mooer.

clue.text: Retrial ordered to establish what vehicle followed

indicators.note: the court ordering things here means putting the letters in a fresh order

explanation.surface: A judge orders a new hearing to determine which car was tailing another.
explanation.definitionFit: A trailer is a wheeled unit towed behind a car or lorry, so it follows that vehicle.

clue.text: Cordial monk

definitions.meaning: a cordial is a sweet liqueur; this one is a herbal liqueur made in Normandy
a member of the religious order founded by St Benedict

explanation.definitionFit: The herbal liqueur is named after the Benedictine order of monks that first made it.

clue.text: Did one's utmost to make progress on the parade ground?

definitions.text: to make progress on the parade ground?
definitions.meaning: soldiers marching on a drill square advance by stepping out, leading with the left leg

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means trying as hard as possible; read literally it describes stepping off when marching.

clue.text: Diners'card

parts.note: not a credit card but the list of dishes handed to people eating at a restaurant

explanation.definitionFit: The bill of fare listing dishes is a card given to people eating out.

clue.text: Grub to provide food and support

parts.note: to cater is to supply food and drink
a pillar is a column holding up a structure

explanation.surface: Caterers bring grub and also hold up the event.
explanation.definitionFit: A grub is an insect larva, and this butterfly larva is one example.

clue.text: Do give me backing in the short march

indicators.note: in says one piece is placed inside the word do

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: backing means the word me goes in backwards

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A request to support someone during a brief parade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' turns the pronoun round before 'in' sets it inside; 'short' marks the definition as a clipped word.
explanation.definitionFit: A demo is a shortened word for a demonstration, a protest march.

clue.text: See 8
A German sausage?

parts.note: a smoked sausage named after a city on the Main; also a person from that city, a German

explanation.definitionFit: A smoked sausage named after its city of origin, whose residents bear the same name.

clue.text: Eight in a row

parts.note: an eight is a rowing crew; a row here is an outing on the water, not a line

explanation.definitionFit: A rowing eight is a crew of rowers who propel the boat with sweeping strokes.

clue.text: Darkness near the beginning of time

parts.note: nigh is an old word for near

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its opening letter

explanation.surface: Gloom close to the dawn of creation.
explanation.definitionFit: The hours of darkness are the period between sunset and sunrise.

clue.text: Direct route to a centre of industry?

definitions.text: Direct route to a centre of industry?

parts.words: Direct route to a centre of industry?
parts.note: the busy bee's hive is a hub of industry, and bees fly straight back to it

explanation.definitionFit: A straight course, like that a bee supposedly flies home to its hive.

clue.text: Be firm when surrounded

parts.note: taken as written
set means firm or solidified, like set jelly

explanation.surface: Stand firm when encircled by enemies.
explanation.definitionFit: To be beset is to be hemmed in or assailed on all sides.

clue.text: Plunger is able to work under water

definitions.text: Plunger is able to work under water

parts.words: Plunger is able to work under water
parts.note: not a sink tool but a person who plunges into water and can work beneath the surface

explanation.definitionFit: Someone who dives in and works submerged, such as a salvage or pearl worker.

clue.text: Partly put in the shade

indicators.note: Partly says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Something is placed partly in the shade.
explanation.definitionFit: A tint is a shade or hue of a colour.

clue.text: All that remains of the broken bust

indicators.note: the broken statue's letters are smashed and reassembled

explanation.surface: Only fragments are left of a shattered sculpture.
explanation.definitionFit: A stub is the short end left after the rest is used, like a cigarette end.

clue.text: Absolutely vertical

definitions.meaning: rising straight up, as of a cliff face

explanation.definitionFit: The word means utter, total, and also perpendicular, like a steep drop.

clue.text: One backing a horse

parts.note: not a punter betting but a craftsman who makes the seats that go on a horse's back

explanation.definitionFit: A maker of leather riding seats and tack, which sit on a horse's back.

clue.text: Form new divisions or purge new order

indicators.note: a new order means the letters of these words are arranged differently

explanation.surface: A party must reorganise or carry out a purge of its ranks.
explanation.definitionFit: To regroup is to reorganise into fresh units or formations.

clue.text: Odd when Bobby isn't on his round

definitions.text: when Bobby isn't on his round
definitions.meaning: a bobby is a British policeman, and his round is his beat; not on it he is away from it

explanation.definitionFit: The word means quirky; split in two it describes a policeman away from his patrol.

clue.text: Eat nuts that are rotten-this will make one ill

indicators.note: rotten suggests something decayed and broken apart, so the letters are reassembled

explanation.surface: A warning against eating spoiled nuts, which could make you sick.
explanation.definitionFit: Lockjaw is a serious bacterial infection causing illness and muscle spasms.

clue.text: Getting close-near the fire?

definitions.meaning: in a guessing game, nearing the right answer
heated, as one is beside a hearth

explanation.definitionFit: The word describes both nearing a hidden object in a game and being heated by a hearth.

clue.text: Cut down when gnarled

indicators.note: gnarled means twisted and knotted, so the letters are twisted around

explanation.surface: A tree was felled because it was knotted and twisted.
explanation.definitionFit: Hewn means chopped or felled with an axe.

clue.text: He is not honest about a bird

indicators.note: about means turned around, so the bird's name is read backwards

parts.note: a rail is a wading bird, such as the water rail

explanation.surface: Someone untruthful talks about a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who tells untruths is dishonest.

clue.text: Chorus girl?

parts.note: not a showgirl but a girl's name that also opens the birdsong of daybreak, the morning chorus

explanation.definitionFit: A girl's name that is also the daybreak when birds sing their morning chorus.

clue.text: Everybody, say, with alternative I state to be symbolic

parts.note: all means everybody
eg, for example, is what say means
or introduces an alternative
taken as written
Cal is a short form for California, a US state

explanation.surface: A claim that everybody's choices make a statement.
explanation.definitionFit: Something allegorical carries a hidden figurative meaning, like a parable.

clue.text: Being in poor health, it is unable to fly

indicators.note: in says the answer sits inside the words poor health, across the gap between them

explanation.surface: A creature too sickly to take to the air.
explanation.definitionFit: This South American bird is flightless, like the ostrich.

clue.text: It is obvious that I leave the vehicles with father?

indicators.note: leave says that letter departs from the word for the vehicles

parts.note: trains are vehicles on rails
taken as written
a father is a parent

explanation.surface: Clearly I am leaving the cars with Dad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leave' takes I out of TRAINS, giving TRANS.
explanation.definitionFit: Something see-through is clear, so plainly evident.
